definitions.explanation: Having the same quality or composition in every part, with no uneven spots. Said of materials, products, and mixtures, and by extension of groups or societies where everyone is alike.

examples.japanese: {均質|きんしつ}な⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: To make products of uniform quality.

examples.japanese: ⟦{生地|きじ}→生地：02631_kiji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{均質|きんしつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{混|ま}ぜる→混ぜる：02423_mazeru⟧。
examples.english: Mix well until the dough is even throughout.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{均質|きんしつ}だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われて→言う：00515_iu⟧きた⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{実際|じっさい}→実際：02502_jissai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧⟦{違|ちが}い→違い：03432_chigai⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧。
examples.english: Japanese society has long been called homogeneous, but in fact regional differences are large.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {均質|きんしつ}な⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧: products of uniform quality
- ⟦{均質化|きんしつか}→均質化：23592_kinshitsuka⟧: homogenization; becoming uniform
- {均質|きんしつ}な⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧: a homogeneous society

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{同質|どうしつ}→同質：32067_doushitsu⟧: of the same nature, comparing two or more things; {均質|きんしつ} describes one thing that is even all through
- ⟦{均一|きんいつ}→均一：12049_kinitsu⟧: uniform, said especially of prices and amounts ({百円均一|ひゃくえんきんいつ}, everything 100 yen)
